Could you clarify my understanding of your steps so I can try and replicate the issue.

  1. You start in the Unified Inbox, with more that one email listed.
  2. You delete a single email from Unified Inbox.
  3. After doing so, the other emails disappear and you see an empty list.
  • When you delete an email, do you open the email first or delete from the message list.
  • How are you deleting the email? Left/right swipe or toolbar button.
  • When you select the three lines and tap Inbox, are you tapping inbox under the Unified account header, or switching to an individual account inbox.

content: Thunderbird for android is a client not the email provider. You can create a new email account with gmail or any other provider such as Yahoo, icloud, gmx, mail.com etc
